subject: [cam] I revised your vt/ package (opus-cam), please review
body: Files: vt/n2hwenc_vt.c (pipeline with a worker thread, emits only from VT encodeFrame/completeFrames calls, bounded waits, open_with_retry, ENC_SET policy, repack, idle reopen, MaxFrameDelayCount, NumberOfPendingFrames), vt/n2hwenc_vt.h (n2hwenc_set_max_in_flight), vt/n2hwenc_client.{c,h} (timeouts, N2HWENC_CLIENT_BUSY/RESTART, process-wide relay lock), vt/test/t_vt.c + t_fakeclient.{c,h} (new checks; ENC_SET-before-first-picture expectation changed to 0), vt/symbols.txt, STATUS.md appendix. N2TEST P04 PASS 8517/8517. VT facts behind the design: CAMERA_INTEGRATION.md section 3.7.
